title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 086
review_goal: Differentiate shuffle, signature, and snowstorm variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Two separated path arrows bending around each other in opposite lanes without crossing into an X
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants shuffle to read as two separate arrow lanes rather than one crossed X shape.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the crossed shuffle when both path arrows should intersect at the center before exiting rightward.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the shuffle arrows on separate curved lanes instead of crossing them into a central X.

items.depicts_observation: Handwritten signature line making one tall zigzag stroke and one short tail at the lower right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a freehand signature drawn as one loose handwritten stroke with no extra frame.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the signature mark with the diagonal line and curved ring stroke around it.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the freer handwritten squiggle instead of the signature variant wrapped with an extra curved ring stroke.

items.depicts_observation: Diagonal signature line crossing through one curved ring stroke with a short tail below
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the signature to feel more structured with a diagonal line and curved ring around it.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the looser signature squiggle when the mark should not include the wrapped ring stroke.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a diagonal line and curved ring around the mark rather than using only a loose handwritten squiggle.

items.depicts_observation: Two horizontal wind bars pushing toward two small snowflake stars on the right side
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants snowstorm to read like blowing wind carrying snow across the screen.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the cloud snowstorm when the weather cue should start from a cloud outline with snow falling below it.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows wind bars blowing snowflakes rather than a cloud dropping snow beneath it.

items.depicts_observation: Cloud outline with four small snowflake stars hanging below the lower edge
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants snowstorm to read as a cloud releasing snow instead of wind bars pushing flakes sideways.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the blowing snow variant when the weather cue should not start from a cloud outline.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot anchors the snow in a cloud shape with flakes underneath instead of side blowing wind lines.
